title: X1DB - RLP - VA ACC ANNEX | HONOLULU, HI
agency: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.RPO WEST (36C24W)
description_text: VA seeks to lease approximately 19,900 ANSI/BOMA (ABOA) Square Feet of space and sixty (60) onsite parking spaces for use by VA as an Ambulatory Care Clinic (ACC) Annex within Honolulu, HI. VA will consider leased space located in an existing building. See Attachments.
